name: rcopy
description: Highlight part of a Claude reply in Claude Code full-screen mode, press Alt+C, and paste it into Outlook, Teams, Word, Slack or Google Docs with its formatting. WSL on Windows.

defaultVariant.title: What Alt+C and /rcopy copy
defaultVariant.description: rich: formatted text plus plain text. md: the Markdown source. plain: clean plain text. html: the HTML source as text.

tableBorders.title: Table borders
tableBorders.description: Draw borders around table cells in formatted copies.

codeColors.title: Code colors
codeColors.description: Color the syntax in code blocks of formatted copies.
